info.title: Hundred
info.synopsis:
La storia d’azione della “Battaglia Scolastica Definitiva” ruota attorno agli Hundred, avanzatissimi mezzi da combattimento e unica arma efficace contro i “Savage”, nuovi e non ultimi aspiranti invasori del globo terracqueo.
Il protagonista, Kirasagi Hayato, si reca sulla nave-città-accademia Little Garden, per frequentare l’accademia militare e diventare un pilota di Hundred. Qui incontra una bella ragazza dai capelli argentati di nome Emil Crossford che pare riconoscerlo ma Hayato non sembra ricordarsi di lei. Ma non c’è molto tempo per indagare sulla cosa, poiché Hayato viene presto sfidato dalla “Regina” dell’accademia, la bionda Claire Harvey.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: The day of admission to Hayato's Little Garden. Noah and Yukiume, who came to pick up Hayato at the airport, were late for the entrance ceremony and were dropped out by the student council president Claire. It was roommate Emile who rebelled against it. Emile is also expelled from school. Claire challenges Duel to settle with the dissenting Hayato. If Hayato wins, the three dropouts will be cancelled. Hayato plans a strategy with Emile and faces a duel with Claire.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Hayato will experience the first actual battle against Savage in the Zwei Islands. Overwhelmed by the fighting power of Claire, Liddy, and Erica's student organization members, she fights well with Emile. However, the war situation deteriorated in front of the giant species, Trenta-class Savage. Emile tries to protect the downed Liddy, but Savage tears her variable suit apart. There is a bulge in the chest and an old wound under the suit.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: After the actual battle with Savage, Hayato was regaining his daily routine. Meanwhile, the mission of being a bodyguard of the world-famous diva Sakura Kirishima comes in. This is to redo the live that was interrupted by the recent Savage invasion. Hayato is taken by the innocent Sakura. Hayato was wondering if this was really a world-class diva, but Sakura was overwhelmed by the performance using Hand Red at the live venue under construction.

The destination is the Zwei Gorge, a place of memories of Sakura. So Hayato decides to learn about Sakura's past ...

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: At Little Garden, the Gardens Festa was about to be held once a year at the school. Martial arts from various countries are gathering in Little Garden to help with the security. Among them were Claudia and Wendy, who fought together in the previous operation. As the Gardens Festa begins and the inside of the ship rises, the diva Sakura Kirishima and the female scientist Vitaly Tynyanov who turned the trio of Krovanh who were captured and protected by Little Garden into artificial variants Infiltrate the ship.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Little garden that gets excited at Gardens Festa. During the live performance of the diva Sakura Kirishima, Hayato's younger sister Karen Kisaragi took the stage as a singer. Meanwhile, an unfamiliar bee-shaped mecha appears in the city. It is said that the bee-shaped mecha is making noise in various parts of the ship. This was all well planned by Vitaly. Taking advantage of the turmoil inside the ship, Vitaly advances to a room where the three Krovanhs are protected.
